blocks.text: Balanced chemical equation ki madad se yeh types ke relationships parhe ja sakte hain:
In relationships ko samajhne ke liye balanced equation mein chhupi information parhni hoti hai. Misal ke taur par:
Yeh equation chaar tareeqon se parhi ja sakti hai:

items: N₂ ka 1 mole H₂ ke 3 moles se react kar ke NH₃ ke 2 moles banata hai.
N₂ ka 1 molecule H₂ ke 3 molecules se react kar ke NH₃ ke 2 molecules banata hai.
STP par 22.4 dm³ N₂, 67.2 dm³ H₂ se react kar ke 44.8 dm³ NH₃ banata hai.
28.0 g N₂, 6 g H₂ se react kar ke 34.0 g NH₃ banata hai.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind! (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text:
Stoichiometric hisab karte waqt yeh baatein maan li jati hain (assumptions):
1) Sab reactants poori tarah products mein badal jate hain.
2) Law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions poore hote hain.
3) Koi side reaction nahi hoti.
